summary: When the candidate steps outside, the manager lets them know someone will be waiting on their return.
realLife: After Kerry’s advisers reviewed Ohio’s count in 2004, manager Mary Beth Cahill phoned him at home. Kerry called her back with his decision before he spoke to Bush.
inGame: The concession reply follows the player’s selected turn in the race-lost scene.
gates: The candidate has just asked for time alone.

turns.what: The manager leaves a trusted aide by the door and returns to the count room.
turns.pulledBy: The election office is about to release an update.
turns.writesBack: The candidate knows whom to find immediately on returning.

turns.what: The candidate asks the manager to stay and practice the first sentence of the call together.
turns.pulledBy: The candidate has made a decision and wants company for the conversation.
turns.writesBack: The manager cancels the planned break and records the call only after the two candidates speak.
